purpose: Internal B04-F guard that makes canonical Schedule establish and revise reject a placement when current hard Temporal Constraints cannot be evaluated or are violated.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Reads current hard Temporal Constraint rule MaterialStates and creates no state.
state_history.current_binding: Uses the requested Schedule subject and the current constraint bindings as the authoritative admissibility basis.
state_history.immutability_policy: Read-only mutation guard invoked by bounded Schedule establish and revise capabilities.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: Forward-only migration capability; downgrade is intentionally refused rather than re-enabling a hard-constraint bypass.

obligations: hard constraints require an absolute or resolved named-zone placement
unsupported hard placement/constraint combinations fail closed as not evaluable
hard boundary/window/duration violations are normalized to Schedule hard-constraint violations
establish and revise apply the same guard
runtime, migrator and PUBLIC have no direct EXECUTE grant
